gloss: the most; the greatest number; highest count

definitions.gloss: the most; the largest number; highest count
definitions.explanation: The greatest in number or frequency. From {最|さい} (most) plus {多|た} (many). The opposite is {最少|さいしょう} (the fewest).

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}{最多|さいた}の{観客|かんきゃく}が{集|あつ}まった。
{彼|かれ}はリーグ{最多|さいた}の{勝利|しょうり}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: He racked up the most wins in the league.

examples.japanese: その{年|とし}は{過去|かこ}{最多|さいた}の{来場者数|らいじょうしゃすう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: That year recorded the highest number of visitors ever.

notes:
From {最|さい} (most) plus {多|た} (many). Usually attached directly to a noun ({最多|さいた}{得点|とくてん}, most points) or joined with の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過去最多|かこさいた}: the most ever / a record high
- {最多|さいた}{得点|とくてん}: the most points
- リーグ{最多|さいた}: the most in the league

RELATED WORDS:
- {最少|さいしょう}: the fewest (opposite)
- {最大|さいだい}: the largest (in size or scale, not count)
